ITEMS.TITLE: Chatbot
ITEMS.TEXT1: This project implements a complete Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that allows users to query academic publication data extracted from the scientific portal of the Pontifical University of Salamanca.
ITEMS.TEXT3: The website was crawled using Apache Nutch, generating a data file that was later transformed and cleaned into a structured JSON format suitable for indexing and semantic search.
ITEMS.STACK: Python, FAISS, RAG, LLM, Angular, FastAPI, OpenAI (GPT-4 Turbo model)

ITEMS.TITLE: Categorify
ITEMS.TEXT1: Categorify is a full-stack web application built with Angular (frontend) and Express (backend), designed to organize and manage URLs in a structured and visual way.
ITEMS.TEXT2: It allows users to create color-coded categories and store URL entries with metadata such as description, image, and favorite status.
ITEMS.TEXT3: The application is deployed on Render, so it does not need to be run locally:
ITEMS.TEXT4: The complete project is available on GitHub and hosted on Render for demonstration purposes, allowing companies to interact with the application online.

ITEMS.TITLE: Daily Mood
ITEMS.TEXT1: A modern mobile/web e-commerce application developed with Angular (standalone architecture) and Ionic, featuring reactive state management with Angular Signals, a simulated checkout process, stock management, favorites, and a persistent cart.
ITEMS.TEXT2: The project demonstrates clean architecture principles, reactive UI patterns, modular component design, and frontend development best practices.

ITEMS.TITLE: Ledgerly
ITEMS.TEXT1: Ledgerly is a personal expense tracking iOS application built with Swift and SwiftUI. It allows users to add, view, categorize, and visualize their expenses with a modern, intuitive interface. Ledgerly also supports local persistence via Core Data and synchronization with a backend service.
